name: claimondo-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Claimondo's public /api/v1 (Germany, Kfz-Schaden): find Kfz-Sachverstaendige/Gutachter, show bookable slots, check claim eligibility, decode insurer letters, and — with explicit user consent — file a claim or request a callback (personal FlowLink delivered to the customer via WhatsApp). For LLM clients (claude.ai/Claude Desktop, ChatGPT connectors, Cursor).
